title: fix(plugin-auth)!: the Register SSO Provider bridge takes every endpoint /sso/register takes, and the domain-verification answer carries the registered domain
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D58H4hn7mx9bRShF3BfEhTw)_
Fixes #33197

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed, all on `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/request-domain-verification`: a `domain` in the request body is no longer read, so a caller that named one now gets the record name and `domain` of the provider's registered domain instead of the one it named; a provider whose registered domain names no host name, or holds an entry that names none, now answers `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` where it answered `200` with a token (verify-domain refuses such a provider with `INVALID_DOMAIN` anyway); and the door now reads the provider back through `GET /sso/get-provider`, so a non-2xx answer to that read is returned as `DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` with the read's status where the door answered `200`. Widened: `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register` now accepts `tokenEndpoint`, `jwksEndpoint` and `authorizationEndpoint` beside `discoveryEndpoint` and `userInfoEndpoint` (a form that names none of them sends the body it sent before), and the `request-domain-verification` answer gains `dnsRecords`.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：托管用的「注册 SSO 提供方」入口（`POST /admin/sso/register`）现在接收 `tokenEndpoint`、`jwksEndpoint`、`authorizationEndpoint`（原来只收 `userInfoEndpoint` 和 `discoveryEndpoint`）；「申请域名验证」的返回里 `domain` 改为提供方注册时的域名，DNS 记录名也放在这个域名下。
- **为什么改**：Google 这类 IdP 的 token / 密钥 / userinfo 地址不在 issuer 的域名上，注册时报错让你填 `tokenEndpoint`，但入口把这个字段丢掉了，所以永远注册不上；域名验证的返回 `domain` 是空字符串，用户不知道记录该加在哪个域名下。
- **风险与回滚**：注册入口只放宽：不填新字段的表单发出的请求和以前一样。域名验证入口有三处收紧（已在 Clause-② 声明）：不再读请求里的 `domain`，记录一律放在提供方已登记的域名下；已登记的域名列表里有一项不是主机名时回 400（验证本来也会拒）；回读提供方（`/sso/get-provider`）失败时回该次读取的状态码。云端 AuthProxyPlugin 用自己的 handler 调这个入口，需要它也能在进程内处理 `GET /sso/get-provider`（本仓库测不到，落地后要在云端核对）。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts`（`runRequestDomainVerification` 里读注册域名的那段，以及多域名时的返回形状）；`sso-domain-verification-instructed-record.test.ts` 末尾新加的真实栈用例；`sso-discovery-companion-origins.test.ts` 新加的 Google 用例。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-discovery-companion-origins.test.ts src/sso-domain-verification-instructed-record.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 Google 用例返回 200，域名验证用例返回的 `domain` 是注册域名。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The Register SSO Provider bridge names every endpoint `/sso/register` takes.** `runRegisterSsoProviderFromForm` now carries `authorizationEndpoint`, `tokenEndpoint`, `jwksEndpoint`, `userInfoEndpoint` and `discoveryEndpoint` from the flat form into `oidcConfig`, each under the member of the same name and trimmed, the same handling `userInfoEndpoint` already had (the vendor's schema judges each value as a URL). `AuthManager.ssoDiscoveryTrustedOrigins` already trusts the origin of every endpoint a `/sso/register` body names, so naming them is all an IdP like Google needs. The untrusted-endpoint refusal (`sso-discovery-companion-origins.ts`) now says the bridge takes the refused endpoint as the field it names, instead of listing only `userInfoEndpoint` and `discoveryEndpoint`.

**The domain-verification answer carries the registered domain.** `runRequestDomainVerification` used the request body's `domain` only, so a request naming none answered `domain: ""` and a bare label, and a body naming another domain placed the record where verify-domain never looks. After the challenge is issued, the bridge now reads the provider back through `/sso/get-provider` (same handler, same credential, the same `checkProviderAccess` gate as the challenge) and places the record under the registered domain. A `domain` in the body is no longer read. A failed read answers `DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` with the read's status; a registered domain that names no host name answers `400 DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED`. Both happen after the vendor answered the challenge, and the vendor re-answers the same token for a week, so a retry loses nothing.

**Comma-list domains, and why this shape.** The vendor's verify-domain splits the stored `domain` on commas, reduces each entry to its lower-cased host name, and requires the TXT record at `_better-auth-token-PROVIDER.HOST` for EVERY listed host, refusing at the first one without it (`parseProviderDomains` and the loop in `verifyDomain`, `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12). So one record name cannot instruct the admin for such a provider. The answer keeps `domain` (the registered domain as stored), `dnsRecordType`, `dnsRecordValue` (the same value for every host), and:

- `dnsRecords`: one `{ domain, type, name, value }` per listed host, in the vendor's order, for a machine reader;
- `dnsRecordName`: the full record name for a one-domain provider (every provider before this change reads the same name it would have with `domain` in the body), and for a list every name joined with `, `, because it is the one field the Setup dialog shows, so the admin sees every place the record must go.

**Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`: the register-door paragraph names every endpoint field with a Google example, and the request-domain-verification example drops `domain` from the body and shows `dnsRecords`. The "What verification decides" bullets are untouched.

## Tests

All through the real vendor (`@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12), except the fake-handle error mapping:

- `sso-discovery-companion-origins.test.ts` (real `AuthManager`, discovery stubbed over `fetch`): a Google-shaped issuer registers through the bridge when its token, key and userinfo endpoints are named, and the stored config keeps them. CONTROL: without them the bridge relays `400 SSO_REGISTER_FAILED` naming `token_endpoint` and the bridge field `tokenEndpoint`, nothing stored. CONTROL: the token endpoint alone moves the refusal on to `jwks_uri`.
- `register-sso-provider.test.ts`: each named endpoint is sent trimmed under its own member; CONTROL: none or blank sends none; the full body clears the installed vendor schema (reaches the session gate, 401).
- `sso-domain-verification-instructed-record.test.ts` (real ObjectQL over SQLite, real `AuthPlugin` routes, DNS double): a request naming only the provider answers its registered domain and the record under it, and that record verifies; CONTROL: a body `domain` does not move the record; a provider listing two domains answers two records, a record under the first alone is refused `502`, both published verifies.
- `sso-domain-verification-error-codes.test.ts`: the read goes to `/sso/get-provider` for the same provider with the caller's credential; a refused read and an empty domain answer `DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` with no record. The one existing success-path case answers `/sso/get-provider` in its fake now.

## Verification

All readings on head `225eba1e` (this branch merged with `origin/main` at `199e3624`), under the shared verify lock.

<details><summary>Premise check on origin/main (d4fbb4db)</summary>

- `register-sso-provider.ts` read only `discoveryEndpoint` and `userInfoEndpoint` from the form; `tokenEndpoint`, `jwksEndpoint` and `authorizationEndpoint` were dropped.
- `runRequestDomainVerification` built `domain` from the body only (`bareHostname(str(body?.domain))`), so a body without it answered `domain: ""` and a bare label.
- The vendor (`@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12) declares all five endpoint members on `oidcConfig`, validates every discovery endpoint against the request's trusted origins (`normalizeDiscoveryUrls`), and verify-domain checks the record under every listed domain (`parseProviderDomains`).

</details>

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 269 passed (269), Tests 5126 passed, 10 skipped (5136); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, the examples project, and `check:test-typecheck` OK, ledger unchanged).
- The 14 files that reach the changed doors (`admin-sso-bridge-gate`, `auth-handle-request-surface`, `auth-route-ledger.conformance`, `bridge-redispatch-transport.pin`, `in-process-session-renewal.pin`, `register-sso-provider`, `request-json-body-refusal`, `sso-discovery-companion-origins`, the three `sso-domain-verification-*`, `sso-provider-lifecycle`, `sso-register-platform-admin-gate`, `vendor-admin-refusal-envelope`): 14 files, 409 tests passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each committed first, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

- Bridge sends only `discoveryEndpoint` / `userInfoEndpoint` again: 3 failed, 48 passed: the form pin, the Google registration, and the token-only CONTROL (which then refuses on the token endpoint, not the key set). Restored: blob equals HEAD `ee4a5510`.
- The answer reads the body's `domain` again instead of the provider: 6 failed, 37 passed: the three fake-handle pins and the three real-stack pins (registered domain, body domain CONTROL, comma list). Restored: blob equals HEAD `ee4a5510`.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 97 families for this diff; all 97 ran locally: 94 exit 0, 3 exit 3 (prerequisite not met, NOT MEASURED here, CI runs them): `check:skill-examples` (client SDK not built), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (full build needed), `check:type-check-debt` (its closure build did not get the shared lock). `--ran` reconciliation: 97 derived, 94 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after fetching its pinned positive-control commit it exited 0 (48 cases). `check:nul-bytes` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The Setup form (`register_sso_provider` action in `packages/platform-objects`) has a **Userinfo URL** field but no field for the token or key endpoint, so a Google-style IdP registers through the API door but not from the no-code form. Reported to the area thread; not changed here (outside this card's file surface).
- The cloud `AuthProxyPlugin` calls the same `runRequestDomainVerification`; its per-environment handler has to serve `GET /sso/get-provider` in-process for the answer to carry the domain. Not measurable from this repository.
